atoms.b: Hey guys! Lately, I've been trying out new hobbies ((++whenever until where)) I had the time.
Oh, I did the same, ((++because whereas therefore)) I wanted to spend my free time wisely and not on my phone.
And have you guys found something? I've been playing basketball since I was little ((++as_if so although)) I was born with a ball in my hands.
Yes, I really liked crocheting and knitting. I enjoyed creating something ((++so_that while as)) I can gift it to friends and family.
Really? I can't seem to find a hobby that excites me, ((++although everywhere since)) I tried a few.
Oh okay, and have you tried crafts as well? ((++Until Where Even_if)) my teacher told me about it, it didn't come to my mind as a possible hobby.
I never thought about it before, but it sounds so cool. ((++Wherever While Though)) you are, you can always crochet.
Luckily we met today ((because since ++so)) you have another idea for what you can try as a hobby.
